name: SPA Skylance
description: These immensely powerful beam weapons are used by Quarg warships to strike fear into the hearts of all who dare oppose them. After the disappearance of several SPA agents equipped with Skylances after landing on a Quarg ringworld, the SPA created a slightly different version of the Skylance, which would hopefully be undetectable.

name: SPA Scan Blocker
description: The Sayari Plushie Authority uses this Scan Blocker to block incoming CSSF scans and allow their plushie transports to pass by undetected. Combined with false flag Merchant-colored transports, plushies can be transported to any world in human space with minimal fuss.

name: Ship Sniper
description: The Ship Sniper is a prototype weapon capable of dealing immense damage to any ship unlucky enough to be hit by a Ship Sniper. It has a long reload time and uses up energy and emits immense heat every time it is fired.
